mapper.update: update voucher set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.delete: delete from voucher where id = #{id} and status = 0
mapper.select: select * from voucher where id = #{id} for update
select * from voucher where status = 1 and stock > 0 and receive_begin_time <= now() and receive_end_time > now() and use_end_time > now() order by id asc
select count(*) from user_voucher where voucher_id = #{voucherId}
mapper.update: update voucher set stock = stock - 1, update_time = now() where id = #{voucherId} and stock > 0
mapper.insert: insert into user_voucher (user_id, voucher_id, status, receive_time) values (#{userId}, #{voucherId}, 0, now())
